messages:
sam-peopleops: Heads up  several interviewers in EMEA just pinged saying their interviews showed up 3 hours later than scheduled. Report started ~07:05 UTC.

lee-recruiter: I'm seeing the same in the candidate timeline. Candidate confirmed they accepted the 10:00 slot but interviewer calendar shows 13:00.

marta-talent: Which service writes the calendar events? Our scheduler receives ATS webhooks then calls calendar-proxy. Could be a TZ conversion bug.

oz-eng: Pulling webhook and calendar payloads. Example webhook: `slot: 2026-03-25T10:00:00+01:00` (Europe/London). Our calendar call used `start_time: 2026-03-25T10:00:00` without offset, calendar proxy interpreted as UTC -> shows 10:00 UTC (11:00 CET) or vice-versa. 

priya-hiringmgr: So if interviewer is in CET and candidate in GMT, one of them sees wrong local time. Some interviewers missed the call. We need an incident triage.

sam-peopleops: Immediate triage: (1) pause automated invites for new schedules for 30m; (2) send quick note to interviewers to check candidate slot in ATS rather than calendar for 30m; (3) engineering patch to include explicit timezone offset in calendar payload.

calendar-bot: automation: paused outgoing invites for scheduler-service for 30 minutes.

oz-eng: I can patch schedule-worker to always send RFC3339 with timezone offset: `2026-03-25T10:00:00+01:00`. PR #4189. Also adding a unit test to ensure `to_rfc3339()` includes zone.

lee-recruiter: Can People Ops send a short message to interviewers scheduled in next 48h to double-check local time in ATS? Also ask them to DM if they need reschedule.

marta-talent: I'll draft the message and include steps: 1) open candidate timeline, 2) verify "Interview time (candidate)" and your local conversion, 3) if mismatch, hit "reschedule".

oz-eng: Canary patch deployed to 1 node. Running a smoke test by scheduling a dummy interview with slot `2026-03-26T09:00:00-07:00` (PST) and verifying invite shows 09:00 PST for the interviewer in PST and 17:00 CET for EMEA.

sam-peopleops: Thanks. Also we should add a fallback: if timezone missing, default to candidate timezone and add a note in invite: "Times are shown in candidate timezone: <tz>" so interviewers don't assume local.

priya-hiringmgr: Appreciate the fallback. Several interviews were impacted; I've reached out to affected candidates with apologies and reschedule options. Please share the final PR and ETA so I can update hiring managers.

oz-eng: Canary looks good, rolling to prod now. ETA 20m. I'll post the deploy link and smoke test results.

sam-peopleops: Patch merged and invites unpaused. Postmortem items: add timezone tests to integration suite, update vendor contract to require timezone offset on slots, and add a blurb to interviewer training about verifying candidate timezone before accepting. Closing for now; reopen if you still see mismatches. :white_check_mark:
